A black stylus lies detached to the right of the device on a white background. The device casts a soft shadow, suggesting studio lighting.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The buttons on the keypad lack sharp definition; they appear as indistinct dark blobs rather than distinct keys. The screen lacks any UI detail, appearing as a flat color block. This suggests either low-resolution generation or a failure to render fine mechanical details.

The stylus has a slightly unnatural taper. The transition between the black grip/body and the silver tip is somewhat muddy and lacks a crisp mechanical boundary, typical of AI smoothing errors on small cylindrical objects.
The edges of the PDA show slight 'melting' or softness where the highlight meets the shadow, lacking the crisp hard-surface modeling expected of injection-molded plastic.

To check for spatial consistency between the device and the detached stylus, ensuring shadows and perspective align correctly.
To audit the continuity of the plastic shell and ensure no floating parts or merged boundaries between the screen bezel and the body.
To assess the overall sharpness and identify if the blur on the keypad is a compression artifact or a generative failure.

focus_areas: Keypad button distinctness and layout logic
Stylus geometry and separation from background

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the keypad. In many AI-generated PDAs, the buttons merge into a single black mass. Verify if the 'buttons' are structurally plausible individual keys or just a textured patch. Also, evaluate if the lack of screen UI is a defect (missing feature) or acceptable (screen off/glare).
